source.text: Particle 1098 of the 2000 drawn with the seed 20261016 from the population of examples/synthetic-triso-population.json: the thickest buffer of the 2000 (buffer 123.516 um). Closed form of the layered sphere with constant conductivities: matrix 889.49 K, film 10.23 K, outer PyC 0.1879 K, SiC 0.0652 K, inner PyC 0.298 K, gap 0.2264 K, buffer 12.513 K, kernel parabola q R^2 / (6 k) = 3.165 K: the kernel centre is 916.1762 K, 16.455 K above the outer wall. The observed value is FEED's kernel centre, the first kernel cell plus the parabola's rise over the cell's radius. Tolerance 0.1 K = 0.5 % of the 16.455 K internal rise + the mesh bound 5 x 3.165 K / 48^2 = 0.0069 K + the wedge of the solver's mesh (the 2 degree wedge of the sphere with its radii times lambda = 0.999695, 48 cells in every region), which makes every drop lambda^2 = 0.999391 of the sphere's, rounded up to 0.05 K, fixed before any run.
